name: Mussoorie hotels
source: Public reviews of 7 Mussoorie Mall Road hotels from Google, MakeMyTrip, TripAdvisor, Booking.com and Agoda, collected 13 Oct 2026.
trend_note: Destination trends mix every property: a change can come from which places were reviewed, not only from how visits went. Check a property's own trend before acting on one.
